title: SiliconGym: A Versatile Reinforcement Learning Environment for Agentic EDA
title_zh: SiliconGym：面向 EDA 智能体的通用强化学习环境
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with electronic design automation (EDA) feedback is advancing large language models for hardware design and verification. Extending these gains to hardware-engineering agents requires environments that span tasks, preserve state across tool calls, and support large hierarchies alongside parallel rollouts. We present SiliconGym, the first versatile, cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification. By decoupling versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, SiliconGym scales from module-level RTL, testbench, and PPA tasks to multi-round repository repair and full-hierarchy SoC flows. Streaming dispatch overlaps tool checks with generation, finishing a 256-answer RL batch 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek. Using interchangeable open-source and commercial backends, we show that open-source-trained functional correctness transfers cleanly to commercial simulation, while paired netlist evaluation reveals when open-source PPA gains survive commercial synthesis.
abstract_zh: 电子设计自动化（EDA）工具提供的反馈，正推动大语言模型在硬件设计与验证中的应用。要将这些成果扩展到能够多轮操作的硬件工程智能体，强化学习（RL）环境需要覆盖多类任务、在工具调用之间保留状态，并同时支持大规模设计层次与并行采样。论文提出 SiliconGym，一个面向硬件设计与验证、支持跨任务和跨工具链的通用 RL 环境。它将版本化工作区、带预算限制的执行和以验收为前提的评分相互解耦，覆盖从模块级寄存器传输级（RTL）设计、测试平台（testbench）和功耗、性能与面积（PPA）任务，到多轮代码仓库修复和完整层次的片上系统（SoC）设计流程。流式调度让工具检查与模型生成并行进行，与原生 ChipSeek 相比，完成包含 256 个回答的 RL 批次所需时间缩短了 21.9%。借助可切换的开源与商业后端，实验表明，用开源工具训练得到的功能正确性可以迁移到商业仿真；配对网表评估则揭示了哪些开源工具下的 PPA 改进能在商业综合后保留。
key_points_zh: 版本化工作区在多轮工具调用间保留状态；执行预算与验收评分独立配置，便于复用同一环境处理不同任务。
任务范围从模块级 RTL、testbench 和 PPA 评估延伸到多轮仓库修复及完整层次的 SoC 流程。
流式调度让工具检查与模型生成重叠，较原生 ChipSeek 将 256 个回答的 RL 批次耗时缩短 21.9%。
开源工具训练得到的功能正确性可迁移到商业仿真；PPA 收益能否延续到商业综合，则通过配对网表评估判定。

llm_assessment.comment: Versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring make SiliconGym a reusable agent RL environment, with cross-toolchain checks that expose when optimization gains fail to transfer.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 版本化工作区、受预算约束的执行和基于验收的评分使 SiliconGym 成为可复用的智能体强化学习环境，跨工具链检验还能揭示哪些优化收益无法迁移。
